Result: the assignee dropdown surfaces only 1 FS centre owner instead of all 8. Recommend switching /support/assignees + _resolve_assignee to read from db.centers (same collection as /api/admin/future-skills/centers) so ALL centre-owner logins can receive tickets. Right now the OLL centre owner (shreshth@oll.co per problem statement) will NOT appear in the dropdown unless that centre lives in future_skills_centers. Verified with mongo: centers=8 vs future_skills_centers=1.

rca of the issue: Collection mismatch in support.py: `db.future_skills_centers` (1 doc) vs `db.centers` (8 docs). The Future-Skills CRM UI populates the Centres tab from db.centers via /api/admin/future-skills/centers, so admins expect ALL 8 centre-owner emails in the Support assignee dropdown. Recommend main agent point support.py's _resolve_assignee + /support/assignees FS branch at db.centers (same field names: id/name/owner_name/owner_email/owner_phone/is_active) to bring parity.
